A slip: a printed strip showing both game-text strips of the location card (title, icons and corrected game text; the Dark Side strip upside down) around an empty middle, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 January 2013.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-L-ordmantell-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Ord Mantell]] (November 1996): The game text changes: “each of” is added after “If you control,”; “are” becomes “is”; “Your” becomes “Each of your”. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Ord Mantell” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
